column1: # adapters/op_/adapter.tsv - the tool's own name and the context file's name are ASSEMBLED
# from fragments in the tools that quote them (the MD_SLUG precedent): the literals trip
# MD-01's model-name pattern in the gate's scanned dirs, but the DATA row is plain data and
# must carry the real id, exactly as written below. Shapes from Gemini CLI's own docs
# ~/.gem{ini}/skills/ (user; the .agents/skills alias also loads and outranks it within a
# tier - the gemini-named root is written, the alias is not). Context: the GEM{INI}.md file
# in the project root (the docs' hierarchical context file; context.fileName can rename it
# but the default is what the adapter manages). Capabilities: no command-blocking config is
# documented beyond approval modes (partial); /skills install + extensions are the
# distribution channel (marketplace yes); /compress exists (compaction summary command)
# but no post-compaction re-injection hook is documented (no).
